column8: melee: battles between alien races with their own ships, weapons and special abilities. classic: the original rock field.
A named set of the options below (see --list-presets); options you set yourself still win.

auto: every option you or the scene leave unset is drawn from the seed at launch (planet size and gravity, boundary, matchups, palette, glow, trails), so each run differs and the seed reproduces it. off: the defaults.

Which races may fight (at least two): the needle (spread shot, blink), the armour block (plasma, shield), the ring (homing darts, mines), the insect (chain lightning, drones), the crescent (boomerang, cloak), the ram (flak, tractor) and the lance (piercing lance, repulse).
mix: mostly duels, sometimes two against two or three-way. duel, teams or ffa: only that kind (three-way needs three races).
Seconds a battle may last; then the side with the most hull left wins.
Planet mass, as a multiple of the default; 0 turns the pull off.
Planet radius, as a multiple of the default.
How fast the arena closes after 12 s without a hit, as a multiple of the default; 0 never closes it.
race: each race in its own colour. ember, ice, phosphor: every race drawn from one colour family.
Strength of the glow around every line; the lines themselves stay sharp.
Strength of the trail each ship leaves.
auto: fewer particles and a smaller glow buffer on weak GPUs. Hull edges are always drawn at full resolution.
auto: follows the fight, zooming in as the ships close and out as they part, with a punch-in on each kill. fixed: the whole arena, no zoom.
How close the auto camera may get, as the largest share of the screen height one ship may fill.
Fixes the matchups and every battle so a run can be reproduced; 0 = random.
